faces.name: Cyclone
faces.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a wind counter on this enchantment, then sacrifice this enchantment unless you pay {G} for each wind counter on it. If you pay, this enchantment deals damage equal to the number of wind counters on it to each creature and each player.
